training_and_export_scope.resolution: Aspect preserving native NaRecTVResize with pixel-area budget16*max_tokens, dimensions floored to multiples4. Budget is a maximum, not exact token count; e.g1024 gives990 on160x320 source. Changing budget changes pixels/attention cost and requires actual quality/runtime qualification.
training_and_export_scope.existing_source_CLI_audited: Prior public WATE validator accepts256,384,512,1024; it does NOT currently accept arbitrary multiples16 or2048. Standalone implementation must explicitly extend/test before README claims otherwise. Native implementation itself takes configurable integer max_seq_len.
training_and_export_scope.labels: Existing validator permits max_label_length1..25; decoder runs up to25 outputs including EOS, so24chars+EOS fits guaranteed,25chars may exhaust without EOS. Reject unsupported characters/oversize labels rather than silently truncate.
training_and_export_scope.batch: PyTorch training uses variable native shapes/masks; TensorRT qualified reference defaults staticB1. Dynamic batches require separate profiles/parity/metrics; do not inherit baseline headline.
training_and_export_scope.precision: Qualified native TensorRT source uses FP16 where allowed with FP32 Q/K post-RoPE cast barriers and normalization/softmax safeguards. It is not an all-FP16 mathematical guarantee.
training_and_export_scope.orientation: Default disabled. Optional classifier/rotation correction is a distinct pipeline, not free rotation invariance. Quarterturn handling/latency must be qualified separately.
training_and_export_scope.dummy_data: Synthetic dummy notebook/test outputs demonstrate function only, never real OCR accuracy or benchmark qualification.

WATE.observed_modifications: CPU device portability uses tensor.device instead of CUDA-only get_device; deployment/export adapters separate.
WATE.SPDX_gap: Inspected encoder/decoder files lack per-file SPDX headers; repository LICENSE/NOTICE supplies provenance. Do not label all dependencies as original project code.

Pillow_resize_derivative.preserve: PILLOW_LICENSE with upstream copyright notices alongside derived C/CUDA resize code

PARSeq_FastTiny_wrapper.note: Optional adapter must retain upstream and vendored dependency notices; pretrained weight/data rights are separate from code license.
